facts.text: Richard Yeowart is 54 years old.
Robert Hopkinson is 41 years old.
Richard Yeowart and Robert Hopkinson were living in France before the alleged scam was uncovered.
Richard Yeowart ordered Arena Television to cease trading in November.
Richard Yeowart has outright ownership in properties in the UK, France, and Spain.
Richard Yeowart owns a £1.5 million property in Barcelona that is being held on trust following the judgment.
Richard Yeowart opened a cryptocurrency account with Luno Money in September 2019.
Richard Yeowart transferred €275,280 and £480,500 of company money into the Luno Money cryptocurrency account.
Richard Yeowart transferred £950,000 from the company to an account in his name.
In 2019, Hopkinson and Yeowart used €1.8 million of company money to buy a seafront home in Sitges near Barcelona.
Richard Yeowart regularly commuted to work in a helicopter from his home in East Grinstead, West Sussex.
Richard Yeowart is believed to have been living in a cottage in East Grinstead, West Sussex.
Richard Yeowart is believed to have a helicopter pilot’s licence.
Robert Hopkinson joined Arena in 2003 and was marketing director.
Robert Hopkinson was last seen at Arena’s premises in Redhill, Surrey, before the group’s failure.
Richard Yeowart resigned from his family’s agricultural business in East Sussex two days before Arena ceased trading.
Richard Yeowart was tracked down to a home in France near the resort of Le Touquet just south of Calais.
Hopkinson has been found in France by local law enforcement.
Nicholas Cousins is understood to have held a senior finance job at Arena.
Nicholas Cousins is a long-standing employee of Arena.
Paul Froom is a director of Sentinel Broadcast.
Paul Froom is linked to the Arena TV scandal and is being sued by Arena administrators.
Ian Gough-Williams is a director at Thameside TV.
Ian Watson became chief executive of Hotter in 2019.
Ian Watson oversaw a company voluntary arrangement in 2020 to allow 58 store closures.
Edward Bramson is an activist investor who built a 30 per cent stake in Electra.
Neil Johnson joined Electra as chair in May 2016.
